title: Change the frequency: 2 Hz versus 4 Hz

actions.text: x_4hz = A * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 4.0 * t + phi)  # same parameters, frequency changed to 4 Hz

clips.caption: Change only the <emphasis level="strong">frequency</emphasis> to 4 Hz and keep the other parameters as they are.

actions.text:
plt.figure(figsize=(7, 3))
plt.plot(t, x, label="f = 2 Hz")  # plot the data as a curve
plt.plot(t, x_4hz, label="f = 4 Hz")
plt.title("Changing frequency")
plt.xlabel("Time (s)")
plt.ylabel("Amplitude")
plt.legend()  # tell multiple curves apart
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
